title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a NULL… (CVE-2026-80252)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability. This flaw allows an attacker with local access to cause a denial of service by triggering the NULL pointer dereference. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability.
